news.title: SEC proposes transfer agent rule, sets event to figure out round-the-clock U.S. trading
news.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued an agenda for its 24-trading roundtable and proposed a new transfer-agent rule with blockchain implications.

news.title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
news.summary: The group will focus first on a U.S. dollar stablecoin for payments and digital asset settlement, with a euro token a priority for expansion.

news.title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
news.summary: Revenue on Robinhood Chain hit a 24-hour record of $1.9 million, driving a 30% rally in ARB as traders chased downstream gains.

news.title: Musk’s X hit by wave of unsolicited password reset emails
news.summary: Multiple crypto industry figures and CoinDesk staff received unexpected password reset emails on Tuesday, though there is no evidence yet that X itself has been breached.

news.title: Firelight raises $8 million, expands beyond XRP as it aims to make DeFi less scary for fintechs
news.summary: The protocol aims to give fintechs and investors a faster way to recover losses from DeFi hacks, while letting XRP, bitcoin and XLM holders earn yield by backing that protection.

news.title: Bitcoin enters ‘Rektember’ as rate-hike risk combines with seasonality to threaten rally
news.summary: September has historically been a poor month for risk assets in general, and bitcoin, in particular.

news.title: Ethena pushes stablecoins into everyday banking with high-yield savings, cards and payments
news.summary: Ethena Pay offers a 6% dollar savings rate and 5% card cashback, using Avalanche for settlement.

news.title: UK’s crime agency freezes Premier League $13.5 million account in crypto crime probe
news.summary: Authorities targeted funds from a $140 million sponsorship deal with crypto firm Sorare, though law enforcement confirmed no wrongdoing by the Premier League.

news.title: Dell’s AI servers drive a stellar earnings performance, and a raised outlook
news.summary: The company’s backlog has reached $95 billion as demand accelerates for its AI servers

news.title: Palo Alto Networks’ stock falls despite strong AI cybersecurity demand
news.summary: Enterprise cyber threats and AI adoption are giving Palo Alto Networks ‘durable tailwinds,’ according to CEO Nikesh Arora, but the stock retreated after an earnings beat

news.summary: “I paid a significant amount into Social Security.”

news.title: ‘It’s not fair’: My twin brother and I were left houses by our parents. Can I make him pay his share for taxes and upkeep?
news.summary: “I am frustrated and financially exhausted from continuing to invest my own money into  these properties.”

news.title: Dow drops below a key chart level, warning of more trouble ahead
news.summary: The index last closed below its 50-day moving average on April 10, which marked the end of a correction phase that included a 5,000-point drop at its low point.

news.title: Which workers are using AI surprisingly often? Dry cleaners and construction workers.
news.summary: The adoption of artificial intelligence at work has been widespread, but more “shallow” than expected — for now.

news.title: This could be the 10-year Treasury’s tipping point into the danger zone
news.summary: An unrelenting rout has global bond yields touching their highest levels since 2008, driving up borrowing costs for households, businesses and world governments.
